description: Explore Iowa State Senator Molly Donahue’s commitment to tackling the issues that matter most to Iowans. From protecting landowners’ rights and revitalizing rural communities to supporting veterans and advocating for clean energy, Molly champions fair wages, small businesses, and sustainable solutions. Discover her dedication to building safe, thriving communities through better healthcare, mental health support, and environmental protections. Learn how Molly is working to create a brighter future for all Iowans
title: Issues
